response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack engineer with 15+ years across web, backend, and infrastructure, including strong TypeScript/Node.js experience and current work on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks, directly matching the role's AI agent development requirement. His background spans relational and NoSQL databases, Docker/Kubernetes, Git, and CI/CD practices, though direct evidence of Nest.js and Vitest usage is not explicit, and Kotlin experience is missing (Java is present instead).
strengths: Currently building AI-agent infrastructure (MCP, agentic frameworks), a rare and directly relevant match
Deep, broad full-stack experience (15+ years) across TypeScript/Node.js, React/Ember, databases, and cloud/containerized deployments
Strong engineering culture fit: TDD, CI/CD, code reviews, mentoring, open-source project ownership
concerns: No explicit mention of Nest.js or Vitest, both core to the primary stack
Kotlin not listed in skills (only Java), slightly gap vs secondary stack requirement
Long history of frequent job changes (many roles 1-2 years) could raise retention questions

key_factors.factor: Extensive full-stack TypeScript/Node.js and architecture experience
Gaps in specific primary stack tools (Nest.js, Vitest) and Kotlin
